entries.title: Psalms 73:1
segments: <<A Psalm of Asaph.>> Surely God is good to Israel, [Even] to such as are pure in heart.

entries.title: Psalms 73:2
segments: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.

entries.title: Psalms 73:3
segments: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 73:4
segments: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.

entries.title: Psalms 73:5
segments: They are not in trouble as [other] men; Neither are they plagued like [other] men.

entries.title: Psalms 73:6
segments: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.

entries.title: Psalms 73:7
segments: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.

entries.title: Psalms 73:8
segments: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.

entries.title: Psalms 73:9
segments: They have set their mouth in the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 73:10
segments: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full [cup] are drained by them.

entries.title: Psalms 73:11
segments: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?

entries.title: Psalms 73:12
segments: Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.

entries.title: Psalms 73:13
segments: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;

entries.title: Psalms 73:14
segments: For all the day long have I been plagued, And  chastened every morning.

entries.title: Psalms 73:15
segments: If I had said, I will speak thus; Behold, I had dealt treacherously with the generation of thy children.

entries.title: Psalms 73:16
segments: When I thought how I might know this, It was too painful for me;

entries.title: Psalms 73:17
segments: Until I went into the sanctuary of God, And considered their latter end.

entries.title: Psalms 73:18
segments: Surely thou settest them in slippery places: Thou castest them down to destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 73:19
segments: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.

entries.title: Psalms 73:20
segments: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou wilt despise their image.

entries.title: Psalms 73:21
segments: For my soul was grieved, And I was pricked in my heart:

entries.title: Psalms 73:22
segments: So brutish was I, and ignorant; I was [as] a beast before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 73:23
segments: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden my right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 73:24
segments: Thou wilt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.

entries.title: Psalms 73:25
segments: Whom have I in heaven [but thee]? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.

entries.title: Psalms 73:26
segments: My flesh and my heart faileth; [But] God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 73:27
segments: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that play the harlot, [departing] from thee.

entries.title: Psalms 73:28
segments: But it is good for me to draw near unto God: I have made the Lord Jehovah my refuge, That I may tell of all thy works.
